name: Polibeli Group Ltd Class A Ordinary Shares
summary: Polibeli Group Ltd, headquartered in Jakarta, Indonesia, delivers worldwide digital supply chain and sales distribution solutions. The company provides a broad range of services to its business partners, from sourcing products and managing distribution channels to offering warehousing, logistics, brand management, and digital marketing support. Its extensive product catalog encompasses consumer electronics, home appliances, various beauty and personal care items (skincare, oral care, cosmetics), toys, games, healthcare products, and watches. Polibeli also operates the Polibeli Platform, which includes the Polibeli App, a dedicated procurement solution for small and medium-sized retailers, and the Polisales App, designed for sales representatives. Furthermore, the company offers an integrated digital supply chain services platform, benefiting retailers, suppliers, brand owners, and the wider supply chain industry.
